title: Cycle Count for Retail Store Operations

objective.statement: Enable store associates to perform accurate and efficient inventory cycle counts using mobile devices, reducing count time by 40% and improving inventory accuracy to 98%.
objective.businessValue: Accurate inventory drives sales by reducing out-of-stocks and overstock situations. Cycle counts performed efficiently allow associates to spend more time serving customers while maintaining inventory integrity.
keyResults: Reduce average count time by 40% compared to paper-based process
Achieve 98% inventory accuracy across all stores
Increase associate satisfaction with counting tools by 25%

inScope.item: Mobile-first cycle count initiation and execution
inScope.rationale: Primary use case for store associates
Reduces errors and speeds up counting

inScope.item: Real-time count submission and variance tracking

inScope.rationale: Enables manager oversight and workload distribution

inScope.item: Integration with existing inventory management system
Offline mode for areas with poor connectivity

outOfScope.rationale: Separate annual process with different requirements
Phase 2 feature dependent on ML model

assumptions.assumption: Store associates have access to mobile devices with cameras
assumptions.mitigation: Verify device availability in pilot stores
Manual lookup fallback for unscanned items

assumptions.assumption: Backend inventory API is available and documented
assumptions.mitigation: Engage API team early, define contract

uiConstraints: No Modal: Modals disrupt workflow and are hard to dismiss on mobile. Use full-screen overlays or inline expansion instead.
No Hover state: Mobile devices do not support hover. Use press states and explicit tap targets.
No Carousel: Carousels hide content and have poor discoverability. Use vertical lists or grids.
No Infinite scroll: Store associates need to know their progress. Use pagination or load more buttons.

modules.description: Allows managers to create and assign cycle count tasks to associates, with scheduling and priority management.

features.description: Associates can see their assigned cycle count tasks with due dates, locations, and estimated time.

userFlows.description: Associate views their assigned counts for the day
preconditions: User has role: Store Associate or higher

steps.expectedResult: App launches and displays home screen with today's counts

steps.action: View list of assigned counts sorted by priority
steps.expectedResult: List displays counts with priority badges (High, Medium, Low) sorted descending

steps.action: See count details including location, estimated items, and due time
steps.expectedResult: Each list item shows: Location name, item count estimate, due time, status badge
Navigate to count detail screen with Start Count button

edgeCases.scenario: No counts assigned for the day
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Show empty state with message 'No counts assigned today' and illustration

edgeCases.scenario: Count assignment updated while viewing list
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Pull-to-refresh updates list; toast notification for new assignments

edgeCases.scenario: Multiple counts with same due time
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Secondary sort by location name alphabetically

successMetrics.measurementMethod: App analytics - screen load time from app launch
QA verification that all assigned counts appear in list

features.description: Managers can create new cycle count tasks by selecting locations, products, or categories.

userFlows.description: Manager creates a count for a specific store location
preconditions: User has role: Inventory Manager or Store Manager

steps.expectedResult: Count Management screen displays with list of existing counts and Create button
New Count form screen appears
Location selection fields appear
Hierarchical picker shows Zone > Aisle > Section
Date picker and priority selector update form

steps.action: Assign to associate or leave unassigned
steps.expectedResult: Associate picker shows available team members; 'Unassigned' option available
Summary card shows all selections; Confirm button creates count; Success toast displays

edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Warning banner shown; option to add to existing count or create separate
Show 'No associates available' in picker; allow Unassigned selection
Date picker disables past dates; inline error if manually entered

modules.description: Core counting functionality including product scanning, quantity entry, and count completion.

features.description: Associates scan product barcodes and enter counted quantities with automatic variance calculation.

userFlows.description: Associate scans and counts products in sequence
preconditions: Count status is 'Not Started' or 'In Progress'

steps.expectedResult: Camera viewfinder activates with scan overlay
Viewfinder highlights barcode; scanning indicator pulses
steps.uiElement: Camera viewfinder with barcode detection overlay

steps.action: System identifies product and shows expected quantity
steps.expectedResult: Product card slides up showing: Image, Name, SKU, Expected Qty

steps.action: Enter actual counted quantity using number pad
steps.expectedResult: Large numeric input updates; Clear and Backspace available
Count saved with checkmark animation; ready for next scan

steps.action: System shows variance if count differs from expected
steps.expectedResult: Variance badge shows +/- difference; color coded (green if match, amber if small variance, red if large)

steps.action: Repeat for next product or tap 'Complete Section'
steps.expectedResult: Camera reactivates for next scan; or completion confirmation if done

userFlows.description: Associate finds product without barcode scan

steps.expectedResult: Search screen appears with keyboard

steps.action: Enter product name, SKU, or description
steps.expectedResult: Results update as user types (debounced)
Product detail card appears same as scanned product
Number pad input with quantity
Count recorded; return to scan mode

edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Show 'Barcode not found' message; offer manual search option

edgeCases.scenario: Product not in expected location list
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Allow counting with 'Unexpected Item' flag; log for review
Multiple scan attempts, then manual entry prompt
Product card shows distinguishing details; comparison view available
Queue locally; show pending indicator; retry automatically

successMetrics.measurementMethod: Time from scan to confirm per item

features.description: Allow counting to continue when network is unavailable, with automatic sync when connectivity returns.

userFlows.description: System handles offline counting and synchronization

steps.expectedResult: Automatic detection via network status API
Orange 'Offline' badge appears in header bar
All counting functions work normally; data stored locally
Pending count badge shows number of queued items

steps.action: When network returns, show sync indicator
steps.expectedResult: Blue 'Syncing' badge replaces offline badge; progress indicator
Background sync processes queue in order

steps.action: Confirm sync completion with success message
steps.expectedResult: Green checkmark; 'All counts synced' toast message

edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Batch sync with progress indicator; allow background completion
Server timestamp wins; local changes marked for review
Resume sync on next app open; no data loss

successMetrics.measurementMethod: Audit of offline counts vs synced counts
Time from network recovery to sync complete

modules.description: Track and manage inventory variances discovered during counts.

features.description: Review and investigate significant inventory variances before finalizing counts.

userFlows.description: Associate reviews items with significant variance

steps.action: After count completion, view variance summary
steps.expectedResult: Variance summary screen shows: Total items, Items with variance, Total variance value

steps.action: See list of items with variance > threshold
steps.expectedResult: List shows items sorted by variance magnitude; threshold configurable
Detail view shows: Expected, Counted, Variance, Last count date, Recent transactions
Recount mode for single item; updates count on confirmation

steps.action: Add variance reason from predefined list
steps.expectedResult: Reason picker with options: Theft, Damage, Receiving Error, Data Entry Error, Unknown

steps.action: Submit final count with variance notes
steps.expectedResult: Count finalized; variance logged with reason; notification to manager if threshold exceeded

edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Warning banner suggests possible systemic issue; option to flag entire count for review
Show recent transaction list; option to exclude from variance calculation

edgeCases.scenario: Manager override required for large variances
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Block submission; notify manager for approval; show pending approval status

successMetrics.measurementMethod: Time from variance view to reason submission
